where.if: AND (st.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR cg.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR cc.content LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.sql: FROM schedule s JOIN campus cp ON cp.id = s.campus_id LEFT JOIN class_group cg ON cg.id = s.class_id LEFT JOIN course co ON co.id = s.course_id LEFT JOIN staff t ON t.id = s.teacher_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT schedule_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt, SUM(read_at IS NOT NULL) AS read_cnt FROM class_comment GROUP BY schedule_id ) x ON x.schedule_id = s.id
mapper.select:
SELECT cc.id, cc.campus_id AS campusId, cp.name AS campusName, cc.class_id AS classId, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.class_name, ''), cg.name) AS className, s.course_id AS courseId, co.name AS courseName, cc.student_id AS studentId, st.name AS studentName, COALESCE(NULLIF(t.name, ''), NULLIF(s.teacher_name, '')) AS teacherName, cc.schedule_id AS scheduleId, s.lesson_date AS lessonDate, s.start_time AS startTime, cc.content, cc.rating, cc.read_at AS readAt, cc.created_at AS createdAt FROM class_comment cc JOIN campus cp ON cp.id = cc.campus_id JOIN student st ON st.id = cc.student_id LEFT JOIN schedule s ON s.id = cc.schedule_id LEFT JOIN course co ON co.id = s.course_id LEFT JOIN class_group cg ON cg.id = cc.class_id LEFT JOIN staff t ON t.id = cc.teacher_id
ORDER BY COALESCE(s.lesson_date, DATE(cc.created_at)) DESC, cc.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(DISTINCT cc.student_id) AS students, COUNT(DISTINCT cc.class_id) AS classes, COALESCE(SUM(cc.read_at IS NULL), 0) AS unread, COALESCE(SUM(cc.read_at IS NOT NULL), 0) AS readCount FROM class_comment cc JOIN student st ON st.id = cc.student_id LEFT JOIN schedule s ON s.id = cc.schedule_id LEFT JOIN class_group cg ON cg.id = cc.class_id LEFT JOIN staff t ON t.id = cc.teacher_id

SELECT s.id AS scheduleId, s.campus_id AS campusId, cp.name AS campusName, s.class_id AS classId, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.class_name, ''), cg.name) AS className, s.course_id AS courseId, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.course_name, ''), co.name) AS courseName, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.teacher_name, ''), t.name) AS teacherName, s.lesson_date AS lessonDate, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, s.should_count AS shouldCount, s.actual_count AS actualCount, COALESCE(x.cnt, 0) AS commentCount, COALESCE(x.read_cnt, 0) AS readCount
ORDER BY s.lesson_date DESC, s.start_time DESC, s.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS lessons, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(x.cnt, 0) > 0), 0) AS commentedLessons, COALESCE(SUM(x.cnt), 0) AS comments, COALESCE(SUM(x.read_cnt), 0) AS readComments, COALESCE(SUM(s.should_count), 0) AS shouldStudents, COALESCE(SUM(s.actual_count), 0) AS actualStudents

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(t.name, ''), '未归属点评教师') AS teacherName, COUNT(*) AS comments, COUNT(DISTINCT cc.student_id) AS students, COUNT(DISTINCT cc.schedule_id) AS lessons, COALESCE(SUM(cc.read_at IS NOT NULL), 0) AS readComments FROM class_comment cc JOIN student st ON st.id = cc.student_id LEFT JOIN schedule s ON s.id = cc.schedule_id LEFT JOIN class_group cg ON cg.id = cc.class_id LEFT JOIN staff t ON t.id = cc.teacher_id
GROUP BY cc.teacher_id, t.name ORDER BY comments DESC

SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(t.name, ''), NULLIF(s.teacher_name, '')) FROM class_comment cc LEFT JOIN schedule s ON s.id = cc.schedule_id LEFT JOIN staff t ON t.id = cc.teacher_id WHERE COALESCE(NULLIF(t.name, ''), NULLIF(s.teacher_name, '')) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY 1

SELECT cc.id, cc.class_id AS classId, cc.student_id AS studentId, st.name AS studentName, cc.schedule_id AS scheduleId, s.lesson_date AS lessonDate, s.start_time AS startTime, s.end_time AS endTime, cc.teacher_id AS teacherId, COALESCE(NULLIF(t.name, ''), NULLIF(s.teacher_name, '')) AS teacherName, cc.content, cc.rating, cc.read_at AS readAt, cc.created_at AS createdAt FROM class_comment cc LEFT JOIN student st ON st.id = cc.student_id LEFT JOIN schedule s ON s.id = cc.schedule_id LEFT JOIN staff t ON t.id = cc.teacher_id WHERE cc.class_id = #{classId} AND s.lesson_date >= #{start} AND s.lesson_date <= #{end} ORDER BY s.lesson_date DESC, cc.id DESC LIMIT 1000

SELECT cs.student_id AS studentId, st.name AS studentName, cc.id AS commentId, cc.rating, cc.content FROM class_student cs JOIN student st ON st.id = cs.student_id LEFT JOIN class_comment cc ON cc.class_id = cs.class_id AND cc.student_id = cs.student_id AND cc.schedule_id = #{scheduleId} WHERE cs.class_id = #{classId} AND cs.status = '在读' ORDER BY st.name
